modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On November 19, 1999: Shenzhou 1: The People's Republic of China launches its first Shenzhou spacecraft.
On November 19, 1967: The establishment of TVB, the first wireless commercial television station in Hong Kong.
On November 19, 1994: In the United Kingdom, the first National Lottery draw is held. A £1 ticket gave a one-in-14-million chance of correctly guessing the winning six out of 49 numbers.
On November 19, 1954: Télé Monte Carlo, Europe's oldest private television channel, is launched by Prince Rainier III.
November 19 is observed as Liberation Day (Mali).
